results.what: Biographical document: Riemann's membership card for the Göttingen Literarisches Museum, summer semester 1849, dated 10 April 1849

deep.surprise_reason: Purely administrative or biographical item with no mathematical content. It confirms the known fact that Riemann was back in Göttingen as a mathematics student by April 1849.

checkable.asserts: Easter Sunday 1849 (Gregorian computus) was 8 April, so the card dated 10 April 1849 was issued at the start of the 'Ostern bis Michaelis' semester.

transcription_corrections: Signature is more likely 'E. v. Leutsch' (Ernst von Leutsch) than 'E. Leutsch'.
'Halb' in 'Halbjahre' is handwritten while 'jahre' is printed; likewise 'Ostern', 'Michaelis 1849', '10', 'April' and the final digit '9' of the year are handwritten fill-ins.
'Drei' appears in a hatched or boxed field, apparently entered or overstamped rather than plain printed text.
'40' at the upper right is a pencil folio number, not part of the card text.
